title: Google Business Profile for Real Estate Agents: Local SEO Guide
seoTitle: Google Business Profile for Real Estate Agents (India)
excerpt: Google Business Profile for real estate agents and CPs: eligibility, category, description, service area, reviews and a weekly routine for local SEO.

faqs.question: Can a real estate agent have a Google Business Profile?
faqs.answer: Yes. Google's guidelines name real estate agents as an example of individual practitioners who can have a profile, as long as they deal with clients in person. Agencies with a staffed office qualify too. Virtual offices and unstaffed addresses are not eligible, and support staff should not create their own profiles.

faqs.question: Is a Google Business Profile free for real estate agents?
faqs.answer: Yes, a Google Business Profile is free. There is no paid version, and Google says there is no way to request or pay for a better local ranking. Ads can appear above map results, but those are separate paid campaigns and do not change where your free profile ranks.

faqs.question: How does Google rank real estate agents in local results?
faqs.answer: Google ranks local results mainly on relevance, distance and prominence: how well your profile matches the search, how close you are to the searcher or the place named, and how well known you are, including links, mentions, review count and rating. A complete, verified profile improves relevance and prominence.

faqs.question: Which category should a real estate agent choose on Google Business Profile?
faqs.answer: Choose "Real estate agency" or "Real estate agent" as the primary category, whichever describes your business. Google asks you to use as few categories as possible, so add "Real estate consultant" only if it fits and "Real estate developer" only if you actually develop projects.

faqs.question: Can I add keywords to my business name?
faqs.answer: No. Use your real business name exactly as on your signboard and documents. Google does not permit extra information such as taglines, locations or keywords in the name, so "Sharma Realty – Best Flats in Noida" breaks the rules and can get the profile suspended. Put services and areas in the right fields instead.

faqs.question: How do I write a Google Business Profile description for real estate?
faqs.answer: Use up to 750 characters to say who you are and where, what property you handle, one specific true reason to choose you, and the next step, such as messaging on WhatsApp. Include your RERA agent number. Google asks you to avoid promotions and prices, and links are not allowed.

faqs.question: Should a real estate agent show the office address?
faqs.answer: Show it if clients visit your office during the stated hours. If you only meet clients at project sites, set up as a service-area business, hide the address and list the localities you really cover. Google says a virtual office can't be listed unless it is staffed during business hours.

faqs.question: How can real estate agents get more Google reviews?
faqs.answer: Ask every client for an honest review right after a site visit, booking or registration, using the direct review link sent on WhatsApp, and reply to every review. Google prohibits offering incentives for reviews and selectively asking only happy customers, so ask everyone and never write reviews yourself.

faqs.question: How do I track leads from my Google Business Profile?
faqs.answer: Check the profile's Performance view for calls, chats, direction requests and website clicks. Add UTM parameters to the website link so profile visits show separately in Google Analytics, and record "Google Maps" as the source in your CRM or lead sheet, because many profile leads call directly.
